_doc: OT lc_ctrl (translated with -G UseDmiInterface=1: the DMI arm is a plain TL-UL window, no JTAG vendor chain). TWO TL targets: regs_tl (CSRs) + dmi_tl (debug window) — the aux-TL mechanism serves the second. kmac_data_o/i is app channel 1 (transition-token hashing) toward the generated kmac. otp_lc_data_i carries the 320-bit redundant life-cycle state word + 384-bit count — wider than tie width, injected by the harness (RAW = all-zero is a LEGAL encoding, the natural first KAT). pwr_lc_i.lc_init is pulsed by the harness after reset (pwrmgr's init go). Escalation/JTAG tied off.
